alias.description: Unique name across user tenancy in a region to identify an endpoint to be used for inferencing.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

description.description: A short description of the endpoint.

displayName.description: A user-friendly display name for the resource. It should be unique and can be modified. Avoid entering confidential information.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type or scope. Exists for cross-compatibility only.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

id.description: Unique identifier endpoint OCID of an endpoint that is immutable on creation.

inferenceUnits.description: Number of replicas required for this endpoint.

lifecycleDetails.description: A message describing the current state in more detail. For example, can be used to provide actionable information for a resource in failed state.

modelId.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the model to associate with the endpoint.

projectId.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the project to associate with the Endpoint.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
Usage of system tag keys. These predefined keys are scoped to namespaces.
Example: `{ "orcl-cloud": { "free-tier-retained": "true" } }`

timeCreated.description: The time the the endpoint was created. An RFC3339 formatted datetime string.

timeUpdated.description: The time the endpoint was updated. An RFC3339 formatted datetime string.
